info.title: Veterans Affairs Facilities Universal API
info.description: Find Department of Veterans Affairs facilities, facility IDs, contact details, addresses, available services, and drive-time nearby health facilities from the VA Facilities API.

get.description: Finds nearby VA facilities by coordinates and drive time.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude in WGS84 decimal degrees.

schema.description: Latitude in WGS84 decimal degrees.

parameters.name: long
parameters.description: Longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees. Current VA sandbox runtime expects the query key long.

schema.description: Longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees. Current VA sandbox runtime expects the query key long.

parameters.name: driveTime
parameters.description: Maximum drive time in minutes.

schema.description: Maximum drive time in minutes.

parameters.name: services[]
parameters.description: Optional VA service identifiers to filter by.

schema.description: Optional VA service identifiers to filter by.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

maxTime.description: Upper end of the matching drive-time band in minutes.

minTime.description: Lower end of the matching drive-time band in minutes.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
